Title: Azure Security Center—New features announced at RSA 2018

Body.Content:
Azure Security Center released new features in preview at RSA that allow you to identify and mitigate risks so you can reduce your exposure to attacks. These features include visibility into identity and access controls, and the behavior of your registry and configuration files. Security Center also released features to help you keep pace with rapidly evolving threats, including analyzing Azure logs for anomalous admin activity, detecting threats targeting Azure App Service and Azure Resource Management logs, integrating with Windows Defender Advanced Threat Protection (WDATP), Adaptive Application Control enhancements, and identifying malware that persists in memory.

 

To learn more about all these features, new capabilities, and more, visit our announcement blog. To learn more about Azure Security Center, visit our webpage.
